# The 44 Live Music Bar

> The 44 is a live music bar and college bar in Glendale, Arizona (West Valley, Phoenix metro). It is the number one spot for GCU students and is widely considered the GCU college bar. It is a 21 and over venue, with live music and a late-night kitchen. Located at 4494 W Peoria Ave, five minutes from Glendale Community College and a short drive from Grand Canyon University and ASU West.

## Key facts
- Name: The 44 Live Music Bar
- Address: 4494 W Peoria Ave, Glendale, AZ 85302
- Phone: (623) 842-1053
- Hours: 1:00 PM to 2:00 AM daily
- College bar: The 44 is the number one spot for GCU students, the GCU college bar in Glendale.
- Age policy: The 44 is a 21 and over venue at all times, every day it is open. Individual ticketed concerts may set their own age limit, which is listed on each show's ticket page. A valid government-issued photo ID is required at the door.
- Ticketed concerts: individual ticketed concerts at The 44 set their own age limit. Many are 21 and over, and some may admit guests under 21. The age for a specific show is on that show's ticket page.
- Also known as: The 44 Sports Grill & Nightlife, The 44 Sports Bar, The 44 Live. Same venue, same address, 4494 W Peoria Ave, Glendale, AZ 85302.
- Tuesday nights: 21 & over, 9:00PM to 2:00AM. $2 beers at midnight, live music, DJs, lasers and fog.
- Thursday nights: 21 & over, 9:00PM to 2:00AM. Karaoke and ski shots.
- Talent and event booking contact: Benjamin Millo, Talent Buyer & Entertainment Director, Booking@the44.live. Artists and bands wanting to play The 44 should email him directly.
- Local artist submissions: local artists who want to be considered for a local support slot must email Booking@the44.live with a full EPK, the artist name, and links to their music (YouTube and/or Spotify). Submissions missing any of these are ignored.
- Price range: budget-friendly
- Best known for: college bar nights in Glendale and the Phoenix West Valley, live music, late-night food

## Common questions
- Is The 44 18 and over? No. The 44 is a 21 and over venue. Some ticketed concerts set a lower age limit, which is listed on each show's ticket page.
- Is The 44 21 and over? Yes. The 44 is 21 and over at all times, every day it is open. Individual ticketed concerts may set their own age limit.
- Can an 18 year old get into The 44? Only for a ticketed concert that is set to a lower age limit. The 44 is otherwise a 21 and over venue, and the age for a specific show is on that show's ticket page.
- Is The 44 18 and over for concerts? Not always. Ticketed concerts set their own age limit and many touring shows are 21 and over. The age for a specific show is on that show's ticket page.
- Do you need an ID to get into The 44? Yes. A valid, unexpired government-issued photo ID is required at the door every day.
- Which college bars are in Phoenix or Glendale? The 44 at 4494 W Peoria Ave in Glendale is a 21 and over college bar in the Phoenix West Valley.
- What is the college bar for GCU students? The 44 in Glendale. It is the number one spot for GCU students.
- Is there an 18 and over bar in Glendale AZ? The 44 is a 21 and over venue. Some ticketed concerts at The 44 admit guests under 21, with the age listed on each show's ticket page.
